messages:
Ben Miller: Heads up — noticed a 429 spike for org=acme yesterday after the rollout. Dashboard shows per-org limit at 95% but per-key at ~30%. Anyone else seeing this?

SRE-Bot: Alert fired: quota_exhaustion_high (429 rate) for org=acme — 5m avg 18/min. Incident: #4762.

Priya Kapoor: Saw that. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/qp123/quota-429-overview?org=acme — alerts flapping during peak batch job. Suspect burst token exhaustion from ingestion jobs.

Jordan Lee: Is this the new burst-window config? We changed per-key burst to 100 rps with 1s refill on dedicated keys last week.

Maya Chen: We didn't touch per-org pools. My hunch: lots of keys under same org hitting pooled per-org bucket, causing org-level throttling while keys individually remain under per-key thresholds.

Ben Miller: Repro steps I ran: load test with 50 keys concurrently, each ~50 rps short bursts. Logs show 429s with header `X-RateLimit-Reason: org_quota_exhausted`. Example log line: `WARN quota: org=acme key=k-abc status=429 reason=org_quota_exhausted tokens_left=0`.

Priya Kapoor: Proposals: 1) increase alert aggregation to 5m to reduce flapping; 2) add a "burst_drop_rate" metric to dashboard (count of 429s where reason=burst); 3) temporary auto-escalation route to CS for impacted accounts (only for sustained 5m alerts).

Jordan Lee: Draft Grafana alert expression for org-level sustained 429s:

```
sum(rate(api_response{status=~"429",reason="org_quota"}[5m])) by (org) > 0.5
```

Tune threshold to ~0.5 rps sustained (we discussed on oncall earlier).

Maya Chen: Also add a panel for single-key anomaly detection (sudden spike from one key):

```
delta = increase(api_requests_total[1m])
if delta > 100 then flag
```

(not exact, but idea: surface keys with >100 req/min spikes).

CS-Lead (Alex R.): @Priya if we change alerting window will CS see fewer noise tickets? We need high precision for customer-facing incidents.

Priya Kapoor: Yes — plan: 1m noisy alerts → route to SRE oncall (pager), 5m consolidated alerts → #customer-impact for CS. Also add delayed webhook enrichment with top-3 offending keys + recent token-bucket stats so CS gets context.

Ben Miller: Do we have a playbook entry? Current runbook references 429-playbook-v1 which assumes per-key only. Needs update for org-pool cases.

Jordan Lee: I'll update the runbook. Steps to add: 1) check X-RateLimit headers from recent requests; 2) call internal quota status endpoint: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" "https://api.redwood.internal/admin/quotas?org=acme"`; 3) inspect redis token-bucket keys for org: `redis-cli --scan | grep quota:org:acme` and check fill/used counters.

SRE-Bot: Deploy bot: rolled out quota-service patch 2026-03-10T08:12Z -> change in refill logic (commit abc123).

Maya Chen: After rollout I patched dashboard panels: added `org_token_bucket_fill_rate` and `burst_released` traces. Early look shows decreased 429s overall but still occasional flares around scheduled batch windows.

Priya Kapoor: Action items: Jordan update alerts in Grafana (assign to @Jordan), Maya refine dashboard panels (assign to @Maya), Ben update runbook and CS playbook (assign to @Ben). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to validate changes and check alerts.

Ben Miller: :thumbsup: I'll open PRs for the runbook and CS playbook, and document the mitigation steps (including temporary quota bump request process).

CS-Lead (Alex R.): Thanks — please cc me when updating playbook. We need to notify top impacted accounts with mitigation steps and ETA.

Ben Miller: Adding implementation note: plan to include a `Retry-After` / `X-Suggested-Backoff` header in 429 responses for SDKs, and emit `retry_suggestion` in telemetry so CS/admins can recommend concrete retries.

Priya Kapoor: Sounds good. If we get fewer noisy alerts after the changes, we'll close #4762; otherwise escalate to infra for short-term org quota increases.

Jordan Lee: I'll push the grafana alert PR today and link the runbook updates.

Maya Chen: I'll keep an eye on the next peak window and post a quick summary in this thread tomorrow morning.

SRE-Bot: Alert resolved: quota_exhaustion_high for org=acme — state -> OK (sustained 10m low).
